claim: Reading 曲がる from its kanji gives 'to bend', and the back only says 'To turn', so a learner who answered from the kanji card cannot tell whether they were right or which kind of turning is meant.
evidence: Front: '曲がる'. Back: 'Answer: To turn / Says: magaru'. The kanji card r-0a82dc79f717 in the same unit: '曲 ... Answer: Bend / Says: kyoku / ma'.
fix: Widen the English to something like 'To turn (a corner, right/left); to bend' so the kanji's meaning and the word's main use are both confirmed.
verdictReason: The card is faithful to the book, which glosses 曲がる only as "turn" (左に曲がる "turn left", 右に曲がる "turn right"); "To turn" answers no other card in the collection (the nearest is 消す "To turn off; to erase"), and the reading rules do not ask a word card to echo its kanji card, whose KANJIDIC gloss "Bend" is also correct. A faithful card whose gloss looks narrow is not a finding.

claim: The ordinals 一つ目 and 二つ目 from the directions list have no card, and the 目 character card ships with no word in the deck using it.
evidence: Book, Useful Expressions: "二つ目の角を左に曲がる (turn left at the second corner)", "一つ目の信号を右に曲がる (turn right at the first traffic light)". Excluded cards r-66edc6705ac4 and r-bbd9c5c83d29 say "Its words are carded on their own: 角, 左, 曲がる" and "信号, 右, 曲がる", leaving out 二つ目 and 一つ目. r-3a0ea34a22f0 目 "Eye" is the only trace.
fix: Add word cards for 一つ目 "First (in order)" and 二つ目 "Second (in order)", or drop the 目 card until a word uses it.
verdictReason: Grepped every cards.json in the collection: no card has target 一つ目 or 二つ目. The exclusion reasons on r-66edc6705ac4 and r-bbd9c5c83d29 list only 角, 左, 曲がる and 信号, 右, 曲がる, so these words fell through the words-only cut while 曲がる, 渡る, 信号 and 左側 were added from sibling phrases (rule 6: each taught word in a cut phrase is still a card). The 目 claim is also true for this unit (no shipping word here uses it; later ones do: 行目 ch-12, 目医者 ch-13, 一行目 ch-18, 目次 ch-21), but dropping the 目 card is not the fix: every kanji in the unit gets a KANJIDIC card by design and r-3a0ea34a22f0 is delivered. Fix is the two word cards. Note for the fixer: 一つ/二つ are not in the ledger (Genki counts them in Lesson 9), so the cards stand on the directions list alone, as the book does.

claim: 右側 from the directions list is not carded in this unit, though its pair 左側 was added here; the learner first meets 右側 in chapter-19.
evidence: Book, Useful Expressions: "道の右側 (right side of the street)". Excluded r-c7cca58e0298 says "Its words are carded on their own: 道, 右側", but the only 右側 card is r-ed9d988c2f60 in chapter-19 (Chapter 20: Reading and Writing 6). 左側 got r-f84bbc7925a0 in this unit.
fix: Card 右側 "Right side" in this chapter beside 左側, and drop or move the chapter-19 duplicate.
verdictReason: Grepped every cards.json: the only 右側 card is r-ed9d988c2f60 in chapter-19 (Chapter 20: R&W 6), while r-f84bbc7925a0 左側 "Left side" was added to this unit from the sibling phrase. The exclusion reason on r-c7cca58e0298 ("Its words are carded on their own: 道, 右側") is false for a learner at this chapter. Caveat for the fixer: preflight enforces one card per written form across the collection, so adding 右側 here means removing the chapter-19 card, and anki-delivered.json lists r-ed9d988c2f60 as delivered; that removal is a scheduling-aware step for the owner.

claim: The vocabulary entries すぐ and つける, and the expression note on どうも, have no card anywhere in the collection, though the reading report drops them as already in the kana deck.
evidence: Book vocabulary: "*すぐ right away", "つける to turn on（〜を）"; Expression Notes: "どうも is normally used with ありがとう ...". reading-report.json drops すぐ and つける with "a kana word: carded in the collection's kana deck, not in a chapter". chapter-26 (Chapter 00: Kana) has no item with target すぐ, つける or どうも.
fix: Add すぐ "Right away" and つける "To turn on" (and どうも) to the kana deck, or make the drop reason say they were not selected.
verdictReason: Not a gap, by design. The kana deck is a budgeted selection, not a complete list: docs/designs/reading-decks/09-kana-deck.md (owner, 2026-09-24) chooses 150 hiragana-only and 150 katakana words from the whole book's kanaPools for sound-unit coverage, so most chapters' kana words are deliberately uncarded. すぐ, つける, どうもありがとう and どうもすみません sit in chapter-7's kanaPool and were not chosen; どうも itself is an expression note, not a vocabulary entry. The only thing wrong is the drop-reason string in reading-report.json ("carded in the collection's kana deck" over-states "offered to"), which is a tooling message, not a card.

claim: The deck cards most labels of the Culture Note school diagram but skips the rest of the same diagram and calendar.
evidence: Book, Culture Notes: "短期大学 （短大） Junior College", "義務教育 Compulsory Education", "夏休み Summer Vacation 冬休み Winter Vacation 春休み Spring Vacation". Carded from the same diagram: 大学院, 短期大学, 保育園, 幼稚園, 小学校, 中学校, 高等学校. No card in the collection for 短大, 義務教育, 夏休み, 冬休み or 春休み.
fix: Either card the remaining labels or treat the culture note as uncarded, consistently.
verdictReason: Facts hold: no card anywhere for 短大, 義務教育, 夏休み, 冬休み or 春休み, while 大学院, 短期大学, 保育園, 幼稚園, 小学校, 中学校 and 高等学校 from the same diagram are carded here. Whether a culture-note diagram counts as something the chapter "teaches you to read" is not settled by card-rules-reading rule 1, which names vocabulary tables, set-expression lists and character tables in, and dialogues, exercises and headings out, and says nothing about culture notes. An owner ruling on culture-note labels would settle it. If they are in, 短大 is the strongest candidate (the book's bracketed short form, parallel to 高校 and 中学 which are carded, and it would need the same reading-distinct-english acknowledgement beside 短期大学); 義務教育 is a legend entry and the three 休み labels sit in a calendar graphic with 夏 and 冬 not yet carded.
